papers.headline: The δ Scuti instability strip and period-luminosity relation as seen by TESS and Gaia DR3
papers.summary: We present an asteroseismic survey of 1,526,218 A- and F-type stars in and around the δ Scuti instability strip using TESS 10-minute cadence data, which resolve the full δ Scuti pulsation spectra across nearly the entire sky.
papers.title: The δ Scuti instability strip and period-luminosity relation as seen by TESS and Gaia DR3

papers.headline: PRISMS GHZ8: Evidence for a Young Burst and Potential Merger Activity at z=10.23
papers.summary: UV-bright galaxies in the early Universe provide important constraints on the rapid build-up of stellar mass and the sources responsible for cosmic reionization. However, the physical processes that drive their high UV luminosities remain unclear.
papers.title: PRISMS GHZ8: Evidence for a Young Burst and Potential Merger Activity at z=10.23

papers.headline: Field-level inference under pressure: the information content of the thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich field
papers.summary: The thermal Sunyaev–Zel'dovich (tSZ) field is highly non-Gaussian and contains cosmological information that cannot be fully captured by its angular power spectrum.
papers.title: Field-level inference under pressure: the information content of the thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich field
